patterns.name: Actix-web route registered without authentication middleware
patterns.description: A file using Actix-web registers HTTP routes but does not apply any authentication middleware. Actix-web applies middleware via .wrap() on the App, Scope, or Resource: App::new().wrap(HttpAuthentication::bearer(validator)). Authentication can also be applied per-scope using web::scope('/api').wrap(auth_middleware). This check fires when a file registers routes (via .route(), .service(), or HTTP method shortcuts) but calls no recognised authentication function. Note: request extractors that carry auth state (e.g. Identity, a custom AuthUser extractor) also count — if the file calls any matching auth function, this check will not fire.
patterns.message: File {file} registers Actix-web routes without calling any authentication middleware or auth extractor. {count}/{total} other file(s) in this package use auth. Apply .wrap(HttpAuthentication::bearer(validator)) on the App or Scope, or use per-route auth extractors.

patterns.name: Axum route registered without authentication middleware or extractor
patterns.description: A file using Axum registers HTTP routes but does not apply any authentication. Axum supports two auth patterns: (1) Tower middleware layers — Router::new().layer(auth_layer) where auth_layer is typically a ValidateRequest layer or a custom tower::Layer; (2) Extractor-based auth — handler functions receive a type implementing FromRequestParts that carries auth state (e.g. a custom Claims or AuthUser extractor). This check fires when a file registers routes via .route(), .nest(), or .merge() but calls no recognised authentication function. The framework gate fires only when 'axum' is imported.
patterns.message: File {file} registers Axum routes without calling any authentication function or auth extractor. {count}/{total} other file(s) in this package use auth. Apply Router::new().layer(auth_middleware) for Tower-based auth, or add a FromRequestParts extractor to handler signatures for per-handler auth.

patterns.name: Rocket route mounted without authentication fairing or guard
patterns.description: A file using Rocket mounts routes but does not apply any authentication. Rocket provides two auth mechanisms: (1) Fairings (middleware) — applied via .attach(AuthFairing) on the Rocket instance before launch; (2) Request guards — handler function parameters that implement FromRequest (e.g. AuthToken, Claims, a custom User guard). This check fires when a file calls .mount() but calls no recognised auth function. Note: request guard types in handler signatures are typically represented as type references rather than function calls in the AST — use this finding as a prompt to review whether each mounted route requires authentication.
patterns.message: File {file} mounts Rocket routes without calling any authentication fairing or guard function. {count}/{total} other file(s) in this package use auth. Apply .attach(AuthFairing) for global auth, or add a request guard type parameter to each handler function that requires authentication.
